definitions.name: acromion
definitions.paraphrase: Lateral acromial border crossing of the tape construction from the trapezius point over the clavicle point; requires the specified landmark construction, not an arbitrary AC joint centre.

definitions.name: cervicale
definitions.paraphrase: Most prominent palpable C7 spinous point. The footnote distinguishes this from the earlier ANSUR superior-point convention. Palpation and prominence ambiguity are part of the procedure, not a vertebral body centre definition.

definitions.name: radiale
definitions.paraphrase: Superior point of the external/lateral radial border, located by palpating the upper radius from the lateral elbow; not the humeroradial articular centre.

definitions.name: stylion
definitions.paraphrase: Inferior point of the radius, with dorsal and ventral extensions marked. The right elbow is bent during landmark location; palpation can be obscured by tendons. Not a generic radiocarpal joint centre.

definitions.name: suprasternale
definitions.paraphrase: Inferior point of the sternum's jugular notch, located by palpation while standing.

definitions.name: radiale_stylion_length
definitions.paraphrase: Right radiale-to-stylion span with a beam caliper parallel to the arm's long axis and light skin contact; standing with relaxed arms and right palm forward. Neither endpoint may be replaced by a joint centre.

definitions.name: wrist_height
definitions.paraphrase: Vertical floor-to-stylion distance with heels together, straight elbow/wrist/fingers, relaxed shoulders, arms lightly against the sides and palms medial; maximum during quiet respiration without shoulder movement. Section 6.4.93 is wrist circumference, not wrist height.

definitions.name: clavicle_point
definitions.paraphrase: Palpated most superior point at each lateral clavicular end in standing posture; not simply an AC joint centre.

definitions.name: neck_lateral
definitions.paraphrase: Side marks at the lower edge of a tape placed around the neck base using the neck-base-circumference procedure, while looking straight ahead.

definitions.name: trapezius_point
definitions.paraphrase: Crossing of the palpated anterior trapezius boundary and lateral neck mark; opposite-shoulder hand placement helps identify the muscle boundary. This is a soft-tissue dependent surface construction.

inferences_not_source_numeric_results: The two forearm-related measurements specify different palm postures; shared model coordinates are not automatically measurement-compatible.
Surface landmark definitions do not establish offsets to the existing model's joint or body centres.
Definition verification does not validate population targets, model marker placement or a source-to-rig registration.
